Frontend decodes one layer, validates a relative logical locator still containing %2e/%2f, and authorizes general. Client passes that decoded locator as URI-encoded provider input without re-encoding. Provider decodes again and normalizes /general/../vault/budget to /vault/budget, returning north vault body. Full supplied provider semantics establish access; no symlink, external URL decoder or guessed runtime behavior needed. Same root cause affects head metadata. Direct or single-encoded parent segments are rejected, and caller cannot select another tenant.
